description: Deterministic semantic hierarchy for Knowledge Database V2.

levels.name: Domain
levels.description: Top-level semantic field such as BaZi, Interpretation, or Report.

levels.name: Category
levels.description: Stable subdivision within a domain used for packaging and indexing.

levels.name: Knowledge Package
levels.description: Deployable unit of related knowledge objects.

levels.name: Knowledge Record
levels.description: Canonical V2 envelope for one knowledge object.

levels.name: Rule
levels.description: Atomic analytical knowledge unit when the record type is rule.

levels.name: Condition
levels.description: Activation predicate belonging to a rule.

levels.name: Result
levels.description: Declared outcome of a matched rule.

path_template: Domain > Category > Knowledge Package > Knowledge Record > Rule > Condition > Result
determinism_rules: Every record declares exactly one primary domain.
Every rule belongs to exactly one package.
Conditions and results never exist outside a parent rule.
Traversal order is level-ascending by hierarchy.json level numbers.
Sibling ordering within a level uses stable id ascending sort.
